decision.summary: NO_ACTION: no take-profit management is justified and reconciliation blocks any fresh BTC daily entry.
decision.rationale: Active strategy is beecthor. Trade log shows an open daily thesis position in `will-bitcoin-dip-to-80k-on-may-15` Yes from 10:24 UTC, but `account_state.json` still shows zero open positions, so account state and trade log are not coherent. Under the playbook, that reconciliation break hard-blocks any new entry. For management, the same 80k DIP Yes is only around 0.57 at the 12:00 snapshot with BTC near 80616, well below the 80-85% partial take-profit zone and far from the 90-95% full take-profit zone; stop-loss exits are disabled, so there is nothing to close or reduce. BTC has rebounded from the 10:00 downside push, which also removes the earlier bearish urgency rather than creating a new clean edge.
